```{ojs}
//| label: train-model
train_trigger = {
  // Expose training fn to the button via window
  window._trainModel = () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("train-btn");
    if (btn) { btn.classList.add("loading"); btn.querySelector(".btn-spinner").style.display = "block"; }

    // Small delay so the spinner renders before the JS blocks the thread
    setTimeout(() => {
      // ── 1. Build feature matrix from active_data ──────────────────────────
      const getP = (g, c) => (g === "Male") ? (c === "Positive" ? params_mp : params_mn) : (c === "Positive" ? params_fp : params_fn);

      const featurize = (d, gDisp, cSep) => {
        const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.group, d.original_class || d.class));
        return [
          nx + (d.group === "Female" ? gDisp : 0),
          ny + ((d.original_class || d.class) === "Positive" ? cSep : 0)
        ];
      };

      const X_train = active_data.map(d => featurize(d, group_disparity, class_separation));
      const y_train = active_data.map(d => d.class === "Positive" ? 1 : 0);

      // Standardize (mean/std from training set)
      const mean0 = X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[0],0)/X_train.length;
      const mean1 = X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0)/X_train.length;
      const std0  = Math.sqrt(X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x[0]-mean0)**2,0)/X_train.length) || 1;
      const std1  = Math.sqrt(X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x[1]-mean1)**2,0)/X_train.length) || 1;
      const Xn = X_train.map(([a, b]) => [(a - mean0) / std0, (b - mean1) / std1]);

      // ── 2. Train selected model ───────────────────────────────────────────
      const sigmoid = z => 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-Math.max(-30, Math.min(30, z))));
      const normFn  = (xv, yv) => [(xv - mean0) / std0, (yv - mean1) / std1];

      let predictNorm; // (xn, yn) -> probability

      if (model_type === "mlp") {
        // ── MLP [2 → 16 → 32 → 1], ReLU hidden layers, sigmoid output ────────
        const H1 = 16, H2 = 32, lr_mlp = 0.05, ep_mlp = 600;

        // Layer 1: [2 → H1]
        const W1 = Float64Array.from({length: H1*2},  () => (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.sqrt(2/2));
        const b1 = new Float64Array(H1);
        // Layer 2: [H1 → H2]
        const W2 = Float64Array.from({length: H2*H1}, () => (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.sqrt(2/H1));
        const b2 = new Float64Array(H2);
        // Output: [H2 → 1]
        const W3 = Float64Array.from({length: H2},    () => (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.sqrt(2/H2));
        let   b3 = 0;

        const fwdMLP = (x0, x1) => {
          // Layer 1
          const z1 = new Float64Array(H1), a1 = new Float64Array(H1);
          for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) {
            z1[j] = W1[j*2]*x0 + W1[j*2+1]*x1 + b1[j];
            a1[j] = Math.max(0, z1[j]);
          }
          // Layer 2
          const z2 = new Float64Array(H2), a2 = new Float64Array(H2);
          for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) {
            let s = b2[k];
            for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) s += W2[k*H1+j] * a1[j];
            z2[k] = s;
            a2[k] = Math.max(0, s);
          }
          // Output
          let z3 = b3;
          for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) z3 += W3[k] * a2[k];
          return { prob: sigmoid(z3), z1, a1, z2, a2 };
        };

        for (let ep = 0; ep < ep_mlp; ep++) {
          const dW1 = new Float64Array(H1*2),  db1 = new Float64Array(H1);
          const dW2 = new Float64Array(H2*H1), db2 = new Float64Array(H2);
          const dW3 = new Float64Array(H2);    let db3g = 0;

          for (let i = 0; i < Xn.length; i++) {
            const { prob, z1, a1, z2, a2 } = fwdMLP(Xn[i][0], Xn[i][1]);
            // Output gradient
            const dz3 = prob - y_train[i];
            for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) dW3[k] += dz3 * a2[k];
            db3g += dz3;
            // Layer 2 gradient
            for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) {
              const da2 = dz3 * W3[k];
              const dz2k = z2[k] > 0 ? da2 : 0;
              db2[k] += dz2k;
              for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) {
                dW2[k*H1+j] += dz2k * a1[j];
              }
              // Accumulate dL/da1
              // (handled per-j below for efficiency)
            }
            // Layer 1 gradient
            for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) {
              let da1 = 0;
              for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) {
                const dz2k = z2[k] > 0 ? (dz3 * W3[k]) : 0;
                da1 += dz2k * W2[k*H1+j];
              }
              const dz1j = z1[j] > 0 ? da1 : 0;
              dW1[j*2]   += dz1j * Xn[i][0];
              dW1[j*2+1] += dz1j * Xn[i][1];
              db1[j]     += dz1j;
            }
          }

          const n = Xn.length;
          for (let j = 0; j < H1*2;  j++) W1[j] -= lr_mlp * dW1[j] / n;
          for (let j = 0; j < H1;    j++) b1[j] -= lr_mlp * db1[j] / n;
          for (let k = 0; k < H2*H1; k++) W2[k] -= lr_mlp * dW2[k] / n;
          for (let k = 0; k < H2;    k++) { b2[k] -= lr_mlp * db2[k] / n; W3[k] -= lr_mlp * dW3[k] / n; }
          b3 -= lr_mlp * db3g / n;
        }
        predictNorm = (xn, yn) => fwdMLP(xn, yn).prob;


      } else {
        // ── Logistic Regression via GD ─────────────────────────────────
        let w = [0, 0], bias = 0;
        const lr = 0.1, epochs = 200;
        for (let ep = 0; ep < epochs; ep++) {
          let gw0 = 0, gw1 = 0, gb = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < Xn.length; i++) {
            const pred = sigmoid(w[0]*Xn[i][0] + w[1]*Xn[i][1] + bias);
            const err  = pred - y_train[i];
            gw0 += err * Xn[i][0]; gw1 += err * Xn[i][1]; gb += err;
          }
          const n = Xn.length;
          w[0] -= lr * gw0 / n; w[1] -= lr * gw1 / n; bias -= lr * gb / n;
        }
        predictNorm = (xn, yn) => sigmoid(w[0]*xn + w[1]*yn + bias);
      }

      // Store model for boundary drawing
      window._model = { predictNorm, norm: normFn };

      // ── 3. Evaluate on fixed balanced test set ────────────────────────────
      // Test pool points use test_group / test_class fields
      const featurize_test = (d, gDisp, cSep) => {
        const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.test_group, d.test_class));
        return [
          nx + (d.test_group === "Female" ? gDisp : 0),
          ny + (d.test_class === "Positive" ? cSep : 0)
        ];
      };

      const predict = d => {
        const [xv, yv] = featurize_test(d, group_disparity, class_separation);
        return predictNorm(...normFn(xv, yv)) >= 0.5 ? "Positive" : "Negative";
      };

      const groups = [
        { key: "Male",   label: "Male",   color: "#1f77b4" },
        { key: "Female", label: "Female", color: "#d62728" }
      ];
      const classes = ["Positive", "Negative"];

      const results = groups.map(grp => {
        const groupData = test_pool.filter(d => d.test_group === grp.key);
        const metrics = classes.map(cls => {
          const subset  = groupData.filter(d => d.test_class === cls);
          const correct = subset.filter(d => predict(d) === cls).length;
          // Precision & Recall for this class within this group
          const predicted_pos = groupData.filter(d => predict(d) === cls);
          const tp = predicted_pos.filter(d => d.test_class === cls).length;
          const precision = predicted_pos.length > 0 ? tp / predicted_pos.length : 0;
          const recall    = subset.length > 0 ? correct / subset.length : 0;
          return { cls, acc: correct / subset.length, precision, recall, n: subset.length };
        });
        const overall = groupData.filter(d => predict(d) === d.test_class).length / groupData.length;
        return { ...grp, metrics, overall };
      });

      // ── 4. Render results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      const panel = document.getElementById("results-panel");
      const grid  = document.getElementById("results-grid");
      if (!panel || !grid) return;

      const barColor = (acc) => {
        if (acc >= 0.8) return "#22c55e";
        if (acc >= 0.6) return "#f59e0b";
        return "#ef4444";
      };

      grid.innerHTML = "";
      results.forEach(grp => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "metric-card";
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="metric-card-header">
            <span class="metric-group-dot" style="background:${grp.color}"></span>
            <span class="metric-group-label">${grp.label}</span>
            <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:0.7rem;color:#64748b">Overall acc <strong style="color:#a5b4fc">${(grp.overall*100).toFixed(1)}%</strong></span>
          </div>
          <hr class="metric-divider">
          <div class="metric-rows">
            ${grp.metrics.map(m => `
              <div class="metric-row">
                <div class="metric-row-label">
                  <span class="metric-row-name">${m.cls} class (n=${m.n})</span>
                  <span class="metric-row-value">Acc ${(m.acc*100).toFixed(1)}%  ·  Prec ${(m.precision*100).toFixed(1)}%  ·  Rec ${(m.recall*100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
                </div>
                <div class="metric-bar-bg">
                  <div class="metric-bar-fill" data-val="${m.acc}" style="background:${barColor(m.acc)}"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            `).join("")}
          </div>
        `;
        grid.appendChild(card);
      });

      // Hide empty state, show results
      const emptyEl = document.getElementById("results-empty");
      if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = "none";
      panel.classList.add("visible");

      // Draw decision boundary on the chart
      window._drawBoundary && window._drawBoundary();
      window._drawTestChart && window._drawTestChart();

      // Animate bars with a small delay so CSS transition fires
      setTimeout(() => {
        panel.querySelectorAll(".metric-bar-fill").forEach(bar => {
          bar.style.width = (parseFloat(bar.dataset.val) * 100) + "%";
        });
      }, 60);

      if (btn) { btn.classList.remove("loading"); btn.querySelector(".btn-spinner").style.display = "none"; }
    }, 50);
  };
  return null;
}
```
